answers.core: I think this is strictly more useful than a class that already exists, with no extra complexity added.
answers.workaround:
Yes. You can't implement automatic refcounting in GDScript, but you can make a RefCounted wrapper with all the methods and an UndoRedo object inside it. This is okay, but slightly suboptimal.

But since UndoRedo is officially implemented, I don't see any downside to implementing a slightly better version of it.
